posts.message:
Getting ready for winter doesn't take a $500 shopping trip. Paycheck 1: water, a can opener, a flashlight. About $25. Paycheck 2: three days of food you don't have to cook. Eight paychecks later, you're two weeks ready.

The 90-Day Home Readiness Kit + the Paycheck Plan, $9: https://preparedathome.netlify.app/?s=fb#ready

One week until Thanksgiving. If you're going home to Mom or Dad, here are 36 small signs worth noticing: the mail pile, the fridge, the stairs, the medicine cabinet. Notice quietly, talk later.

The Home for the Holidays checklist: https://preparedathome.netlify.app/?s=fb#holidays

Happy Thanksgiving. If today left you with a knot in your stomach about a parent, you're not alone. Green, yellow, red: a simple way to sort what you saw today and decide what, if anything, comes next.

https://preparedathome.netlify.app/?s=fb#holidays

The hardest part usually isn't Mom or Dad. It's getting the siblings on the same page. The family debrief: one conversation, one page, everyone leaves knowing who does what.

https://preparedathome.netlify.app/?s=fb#holidays

Ice season is coming to the Ark-La-Tex. The night before a storm is the worst time to make a plan. Water, meds, phones charged, and a power-out plan on the fridge.

90 Days Ready, $9, now with a paycheck-by-paycheck buying plan: https://preparedathome.netlify.app/?s=fb#ready

Winter is when a lot of parents end up in the hospital. If yours comes home this season, the first 7 days are the ones that matter most. This kit covers the medication changes, when to call the doctor vs 911, and who's covering which day.

After the Hospital, $12: https://preparedathome.netlify.app/?s=fb#hospital

Going home for Christmas? You can check on an aging parent without it turning into an intervention. Look, listen, and save the big talk for after the holiday.

Merry Christmas from Prepared at Home. https://preparedathome.netlify.app/?s=fb#holidays

A New Year's resolution that actually sticks: by spring, have two weeks of water and food and a plan for the next outage. The Paycheck Plan tells you what to buy with each paycheck, about $25–40 at a time.

https://preparedathome.netlify.app/?s=fb#ready

Did the holidays leave you worried about a parent? January is the time to turn that worry into a plan: three next steps, who owns each one, and a date to check back.

https://preparedathome.netlify.app/?s=fb#care

The three hardest weeks of the first year of caring for a parent, in one binder: the holiday visit, the hospital week, and the first 30 days. All three kits for $24 (save $8).

The Caregiver Binder: https://preparedathome.netlify.app/?s=fb#bundle

The last ice storm caught a lot of us without water or a charged phone. This time, start with one paycheck: 3 gallons of water per person, a can opener, a flashlight. The kit lays out the rest, paycheck by paycheck.

90-Day Home Readiness Kit, $9: https://preparedathome.netlify.app/?s=fb#ready

You can set up a caregiver binder in one evening: medications, doctors, insurance cards, the people to call. When something happens, everything's in one place for whoever walks in first.

The First 30 Days kit: https://preparedathome.netlify.app/?s=fb#care
